about.en: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated is a US biotechnology company that develops and sells medicines for serious diseases, led by its cystic fibrosis franchise and expanding into sickle cell disease, beta thalassemia and pain. Its common stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as VRTX, and in derivative markets VRTX is the reference equity for products tracking those shares. It is unrelated to the Vertex Protocol crypto token, which uses the same ticker.
